name: Thomas Erskine, Lord Erskine
credit: Thomas Erskine, 1st Baron Erskine, by William Charles Ross, 1823 · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: Thomas Erskine, 1st Baron Erskine (1750–1823), was one of the most celebrated English advocates of his day and served briefly as Lord Chancellor in 1806–07.
The epigram here is the one James Parton printed under the name Erskine in his anthology of English humorous poetry.

poems.title: French and English
poems.author: Thomas Erskine, Lord Erskine
poems.collection: The Humorous Poetry of the English Language (ed. James Parton)
poems.text:
The French have taste in all they do,
  Which we are quite without;
For Nature, that to them gave GOUT
  To us gave only gout.
